changes: Business Actions and calendar tags now use the team directory for colleague names and assignments while keeping staff profiles private.
CVs, work files and personal documents use protected file storage, with uploads smaller than 20 MB and safer replacement handling.
Full backups restore business assets, receipts and milestones along with the other saved sections. Staff records update live within each account’s access.
Role changes apply to the selected space, keep other memberships intact and refresh access in open sessions. Trial expiry and file ownership checks are hardened.
Business calendar links no longer export private staff birth dates, and family carer links stay confined to family spaces.
Business screens have clearer shared-file guidance, read-only viewer controls and work-specific demo content.
